rule: Stone corridors, stairs, and classrooms. Easy going, but every door may be watched.
Lawns, playing fields, and paths. Easy going on foot.
Open water. Nothing crosses it on foot; the way round follows the shore.
Forest without a path. Tough going on foot, and easy to lose the school behind you.
Cobbled streets and lanes between the houses. Easy going on foot.

name: Ruins
rule: Broken walls and old foundations. Tough going, and full of things the school left behind.
Paved courts and cloisters. Easy going, and a good place to meet between lessons.
Flowing water. Cross at the bridge or the stepping stones; the banks are easy going.
Flower meadow and soft grass. Easy going, and good ground for familiars.
Walled herb beds and gravel paths. Easy going, but some plants are not for picking.
Rows of fruit trees and mown grass. Easy going between the trunks.
Dark conifer forest. Tough going, and easy to lose the school behind you.
Rolling hills above the school. Tough going, with a view of the whole campus.
Reedy marsh behind the grounds. Perilous going, and full of small lights at night.
